summary: HCA Healthcare, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a proposed public offering of senior unsecured notes by its wholly-owned subsidiary HCA Inc. and the concurrent redemption of $2.5 billion aggregate principal amount of its 5.250% notes due June 2026 and 5.375% notes due September 2026, conditioned on receipt of net proceeds from the offering. The redemption date is May 27, 2026. This is a routine debt refinancing to extend maturities, not a special situation. Watch for pricing of the new notes and whether market conditions delay the offering or redemption.
